en.name: Salted duck egg
en.summary: Salted duck eggs are made by soaking whole eggs in a heavy brine — around a fifth salt or stronger — at room temperature for several weeks, after which they are cooked. Raw brined eggs keep in their brine somewhere cool and dark; cooked ones keep about 1 week in the fridge, and the yolks freeze for 3–4 months.
en.pantry: The cure itself happens at room temperature: the eggs sit in brine for roughly three to four weeks, sometimes packed in salted red earth, and are then boiled or steamed. Raw eggs still in their brine keep in a cool, dark place, and no fixed number of days is published for that stage — the clock really starts when you lift them out of the brine. A raw salted egg is still a raw egg, with the Salmonella risk that goes with any shell egg, so cook it through rather than cracking it into anything uncooked. Do not keep a cooked egg at room temperature.
en.fridge: Hard-cooked salted eggs are cooked eggs: keep them in the shell at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and eat within about 1 week. That figure is borrowed from what is published for hard-boiled eggs — no agency publishes one for salted duck eggs. Do not wash the shells before storing them, keep them in a covered box away from strong-smelling food, and rotate first in, first out. Yolks separated for baking or for 蛋黃酥 should be used the same day or frozen.
en.freezer: Freeze the yolks, raw or cooked, for 3–4 months at −18 °C (0 °F) — not whole eggs in the shell, because the shell cracks and the white turns rubbery. Lay the yolks on a tray in a single layer, freeze them solid, then bag them so they do not fuse. They come out slightly grainy, which does not matter once they are baked into a pastry or mashed into a sauce. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are about quality.
en.thawing: Thaw frozen yolks in the fridge, never on the counter, and use them the same day. Do not refreeze them.
spoilage: A cracked or weeping shell, or brine that has gone cloudy and ropy.
A putrid or strongly sulphurous smell on cracking — far beyond the usual salty-eggy one.
A white that is grey, runny or slimy rather than firm.
A yolk that is dry, chalky and crumbling instead of rich and oily.
tips: Buy from a shop with turnover and ask whether the eggs are raw or already cooked.
Do not wash the shells — washing removes the natural barrier.
Freeze separated yolks the day you shell them.
Label the box: raw brined and cooked salted eggs look identical.

faq.q: How long do salted duck eggs keep?
faq.a: Cooked ones keep about 1 week in the shell at 4 °C or below. Raw eggs still in their brine keep in a cool dark place, and no published figure exists for that stage.

faq.q: Can you freeze salted duck eggs?
faq.a: Freeze the separated yolks for 3–4 months at −18 °C. Do not freeze whole eggs in the shell — the shell cracks and the white goes rubbery.

faq.q: Can you eat a raw salted duck egg?
faq.a: No. It is still a raw egg and carries the usual Salmonella risk. Cook it through.

faq.q: Do salted duck eggs need refrigerating?
faq.a: Cooked ones do. Raw eggs kept submerged in their brine can stay somewhere cool and dark, but once lifted out they need the fridge.

zh.name: 鹹鴨蛋
zh.summary: 鹹鴨蛋是把整顆蛋泡在高濃度鹽水（約兩成鹽以上）裡，在室溫醃上幾週，之後煮熟而成。生的帶殼鹹蛋連同鹽水放在陰涼避光處；煮熟的冷藏約 1 週，蛋黃冷凍 3～4 個月。
zh.pantry: 醃製本身就是在室溫進行的：蛋泡在鹽水裡大約三到四週，有時外面再裹上含鹽紅土，之後才水煮或蒸熟。還泡在鹽水裡的生蛋可以放陰涼避光處，這個階段並沒有公告的天數——真正開始計時的是你把蛋從鹽水裡撈出來的那一刻。生的鹹蛋仍然是生蛋，帶有殼蛋一貫的沙門氏菌風險，所以請煮熟再吃，不要打進不加熱的料理裡。煮熟的鹹蛋不要放室溫。
zh.fridge: 煮熟的鹹蛋就是熟蛋：帶殼放 4 °C 以下，約 1 週內吃完。這個數字借自水煮蛋的公告值——沒有機構公告過鹹鴨蛋的期限。保存前不要洗蛋殼，用加蓋容器收好、遠離氣味重的食物，並照先進先出輪替。要做蛋黃酥而剝出來的蛋黃，請當天用完或冷凍。
zh.freezer: 冷凍的是蛋黃，不論生熟，在 −18 °C 下 3～4 個月——不要整顆帶殼冷凍，因為蛋殼會裂、蛋白會變成橡皮。蛋黃先單層排在盤上凍硬，再裝袋，才不會黏成一塊。解凍後質地略粗，但做成酥皮內餡或壓進醬汁裡完全不影響。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數講的是品質。
zh.thawing: 冷凍蛋黃請放冷藏解凍，不要放室溫，並當天用完。不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 蛋殼破裂滲液，或鹽水變混濁牽絲。
打開時是腐臭或強烈硫味，遠超過原本的鹹蛋味。
蛋白呈灰色、稀軟黏滑，而不是結實。
蛋黃乾硬粉碎，而不是油潤飽滿。
tips: 向周轉快的店家購買，並問清楚是生的還是熟的。
不要洗蛋殼，洗掉的是天然屏障。
剝出來的蛋黃當天就冷凍。
盒子要標示：生鹹蛋和熟鹹蛋外觀一模一樣。

faq.a: 煮熟的帶殼放 4 °C 以下約 1 週。還泡在鹽水裡的生蛋可放陰涼避光處，這個階段沒有公告數字。
冷凍剝出來的蛋黃，−18 °C 下 3～4 個月。不要整顆帶殼冷凍，蛋殼會裂、蛋白會變橡皮。

faq.q: 生的鹹鴨蛋可以直接吃嗎？
faq.a: 不行。它仍然是生蛋，帶有沙門氏菌風險，請煮熟再吃。
熟的需要。還浸在鹽水裡的生蛋可以放陰涼避光處，但一旦撈出來就要冷藏。
